Yeah, so we had a situation here near Edmonton. Got a call from one of the field guys at
19:38 tonight, October 26. Says he noticed the pipeline wasn't acting right-was being
operated outside its design limits. No leak or release though, nothing like that. Just the
pressure or flow or something was off spec. Not sure what part of the system yet, but the
control room's looking into it. That's all we've got right now.
- Jake, Field Op
